name: The Leela Palace Udaipur
positioning: Palace hotel set against the waters of Lake Pichola in Udaipur, reached by boat
best_for: Travelers who want a palace stay on Lake Pichola with a boat arrival
Guests interested in Rajasthani art, crafts and evening cultural rituals

facts.text: The hotel is set against the waters of Lake Pichola.
The palace halls feature intricate silver accents.
The Guava Garden has marble pathways winding through fragrant orchards.
The hotel has a lakeside spa.
The spa has a semi-private pool for unwinding after a treatment.
The temperature-controlled swimming pool overlooks Lake Pichola.
Guests can take boat rides on Lake Pichola, especially at sunset.
The hotel offers a guided tour of Rajasthani art such as marble sculptures, mirror work and silver craft.
The hotel offers auto rickshaw tours of Udaipur.
A supervised kids' space offers interactive games and creative activities.
The Dining Room serves global cuisine with lake views and a curated wine cellar.

highlights.text: Guests arrive by boat to a palace facade adorned with chhatris and jharokhas.
Guests can join daily prayers at the 16th-century Shiva temple within the palace.
Arq By The Leela, Villas at Pichola is an ultra-luxury villa experience with brass-inlaid wooden floors, Thikri mirrorwork and rare lapis stones.
A selection of rooms have private plunge pools, and most rooms have balconies with views of Lake Pichola.
Evenings feature Rajasthani folk music and dance, ceremonial lamp lighting and aartis at the palace temple.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 45-minute drive from Maharana Pratap Airport, and guests are driven in the hotel's sedans followed by a boat ride.
Not every room faces the lake: the hotel also offers Garden View rooms.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
